top_signals.summary: Pilar Gomez-Bravo, fixed income portfolio manager at MFS Investment Management, and Andrzej Skiba, head of BlueBay US fixed income at RBC Global Asset Management join Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield."
